articles.title: Taisei (TSE:1801) Stock Could Be 25% Undervalued Despite Fresh Share Buyback
articles.summary: Taisei has delivered a very strong 291.3% share price gain over the past 5 years, which puts fresh focus on whether the current market value lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With that kind of long term run and a recent share buyback now in play, the question for you is whether today's price can be explained by the company's underlying cash flows. articles.title: Is Taisei (TSE:1801) Quietly Reframing Its Competitive Edge Through Autoflow Road Localization Technology?

articles.title: Taisei (TSE:1801) Could Be 37% Below Fair Value On Supreme Court Appeal Loss
articles.summary: Taisei (TSE:1801) is back in focus after Japan’s Supreme Court dismissed the company’s final appeal over alleged Antimonopoly Act violations tied to Linear Chuo Shinkansen construction projects and confirmed a ¥250 million fine. At a share price of ¥12,560, Taisei has seen the 1-day share price return rise 2.45%, yet the 90-day share price return decline 15.45%. articles.title: European Stock Indexes Edge Higher, Tech Stocks Fall
articles.summary: STOCKS 0725 GMT – European stock indexes largely edge higher after falling sharply in the last session. Banks and utilities find some relief, though technology stocks slide. The Europe-wide Stoxx 600 nudges up 0.
